messages:
mike: starting gated shift to runtime v2.2 — plan is 10% -> 25% traffic in this window (09:10-09:30PT). Deploy manifest and runbook linked: https://internal.redwood/release/1892. @ashley you own signal, @oncall please watch infra. go/no-go?

deploy-bot: [automated] rollout initiated at 1832106789 — target group: production, step: 10%, version: v2.2. Details: /deploy/1892

ashley: watching latency and error budget. baseline p95 = 110ms, current p95 = 115ms, errors 0.2% -> 0.25%. holding at 10% for two measurement windows (~3m). :hourglass: 

jordan: seeing intermittent 503s from model-pool-3 around 1832106845, small spike but correlated with longer sequences. grabbing controller logs now. snippet:
```
E 2026-03-18T09:14:05Z kubelet: pod model-pool-3/replica-7 OOMKilled
W 2026-03-18T09:14:06Z envoy: upstream reset on connect
```

sophia: metrics: eu-west-1 p95 jumped to 320ms at ~1832106890, CPU pressure on gpu nodes + small increase in queue depth. us regions look fine. leaning pause for eu-west specifically. :thinking_face: 

mike: @ashley need a call — continue to 25% global, or pause and pin eu-west and iterate? we can also target a canary-by-region if you want to continue elsewhere.

ashley: pause global advance. I'll hold rollout and scope a regional pin for eu-west. initiating hold now and notifying infra. :raised_hand:

deploy-bot: [automated] rollout paused at 10% at 1832106990 — reason: manual hold (signal by ashley). No automatic rollback triggered.

oncall: infra status: node pool gpu-pool-2 in eu-west-1 showing memory pressure (80-92%), kube-scheduler pending pods backlog increased. Recommend cordon & drain one node, and scale up pool by +2 before resuming.

mike: agree with cordon/scale. For safety we'll pin eu-west to v2.1 while we fix kv-cache and OOM tuning. @deploy-bot please pin eu-west to v2.1 and revert traffic for that region.

deploy-bot: [automated] pinned version v2.1 for region eu-west-1 at 1832107025. Traffic reverted for eu-west. Global rollout remains at 10% in other regions (us-west/us-east).

ashley: logging issue ticket created: INT-3721 (kv cache size + pod OOM investigation). Will update runbook with increased drain timeout and retry policy. Next attempt after fix and one successful dry-run in staging.

mike: thanks all — good catch. pausing further rollout until post-mortem & fix. reconvene 10:15PT for re-eval unless urgent. :thumbsup:
